title: Menus
desc: Maintain the navigation menu tree and button permissions
emptyCreate: Click "Add Menu" in the top-right corner to create the first menu (directory or menu)
name: Name
deleteMenuConfirm: Delete menu "{{name}}"? This will delete the menu and all of its child nodes. This action cannot be undone.
editDesc: Edit menu details; type or parent changes must satisfy tree structure constraints
createDesc: Create a new system menu (directory / menu / button)
typeDesc: The type determines which child nodes can be attached (BUTTON can only be attached under a MENU)
parentDescButton: Buttons must be attached under a MENU
parentDescEdit: Itself and all child nodes cannot be selected (prevents self-attachment)
parentDescCreate: Leave unselected to make it a root node (directories/menus can be roots)
iconDesc: The icon is shown in the sidebar and menu list (optional)
menuNameMinLength: Menu name must be at least 2 characters
menuRequiresPath: MENU type requires both path and component
buttonRequiresParent: BUTTON type requires a parent menu
